market.title: Will GTA 6 Be Released in 2026?
resolutionNote: Kalshi's own wording: "If GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) has been released on a major platform (PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Windows) by Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
Rockstar's own confirmed release date, November 19, 2026, already sits comfortably inside this window - the market is really pricing the risk of a third delay pushing the game into 2027.

No direct Polymarket equivalent exists for this specific window. The closest Polymarket contract asks the inverse question - 'GTA 6 launch postponed again?', resolving by Nov 19, 2026 - rather than a same-scale 'released by' market, so it isn't tracked on this page.

text: Fans of the GTA franchise looking forward to the next installment have been waiting almost a decade, including a planning stage and then official build stage that began in 2020.
The release has faced several delays and set backs, initially targeted for 2025 but later pushed back to May 2026 - now supposedly some point in later 2026.
Chances of a 2026 release hit a low of 61% in 2025 when that first delay was announced as fans seemed to lose hope in the production, but have since resurged to 80%+.

Recently, multiple [game play leaks](https://www.predictcentr.com/news/gta-6-gameplay-leaks-release-odds/) have caused fans to regain hope, with widely-shared footage implying that a playable version of the game is now available.
Game creator Rockstar has also announced an Extended Look at the new GTA that will go live on Netflix towards the end of August.
